methods.holders: Helius mint history (oldest first): owner balances from token-balance deltas; off-curve owners (pools, curves) excluded
methods.top10SharePct: same balances, top 10 wallets / supply (Helius getAsset)
methods.earlyRetentionPct: first 20 buyers (fee payer gaining tokens against a pool) still holding
methods.buyers: fee payers buying against a pool/curve
methods.sellers: fee payers selling to a pool/curve
methods.devBuySharePct: creator (fee payer of the creation tx) share of tokens bought
methods.freshWalletSharePct: top-10 wallets whose first-ever tx (Helius, oldest first) is < 24h before the bucket edge
methods.fundingClusterMax: largest group of top-10 wallets sharing the sender of their first SOL
methods.priceUsd: 5-minute VWAP of swap execution prices (SOL paid / tokens, ex token-account rent) × Coinbase SOL/USD hourly close
methods.volume24hUsd: SOL value of swaps in the trailing 24h × SOL/USD
methods.drawdownPct: last 5-minute VWAP vs the highest 5-minute VWAP so far
